_meta.purpose: Restrictions on the applicability of held prescribing tables, independent of mutable CPIC quotations. These are table identity and unsupported joint-input states, not new dose recommendations.
_meta.scope: Only the restrictions explicitly listed here. This is not certification of the remaining guidance rows.

fluorouracil.source: CPIC 2017 fluoropyrimidine guideline, PMID:29152729; DOI:10.1002/cpt.911. The supported toxicity warning covers 5-fluorouracil and capecitabine; it is not a generic class dosing table.

clopidogrel.source: CPIC clopidogrel guideline 2022, PMID:35034351; DOI:10.1002/cpt.2526. Cardiovascular and neurovascular indication tables are distinct; a drug name alone does not establish the indication.

omeprazole.source: CPIC PPI guideline 2020, PMID:32770672; DOI:10.1002/cpt.2015. The held quotation is omeprazole-specific; the guideline makes no dosing recommendation for esomeprazole or rabeprazole.

citalopram.source: CPIC serotonin reuptake inhibitor guideline 2023, PMID:37032427; DOI:10.1002/cpt.2903. The held citalopram quotation does not establish sertraline or escitalopram table identity.

amitriptyline.source: CPIC tricyclic guideline 2016 update, PMID:27997040; DOI:10.1002/cpt.597. The held quotation names amitriptyline; joint CYP2D6/CYP2C19 context is separate.

simvastatin.source: CPIC statin guideline 2022, PMID:35152405; DOI:10.1002/cpt.2557. Recommendations are drug-specific.

codeine.source: CPIC opioid guideline 2021, PMID:33387367; DOI:10.1002/cpt.2149. Codeine and tramadol have separate tables.

azathioprine.source: CPIC thiopurine guideline 2025 update, PMID:41618934; DOI:10.1002/cpt.70209. The held single-IM table does not represent compound IM.
